# Atlera Timer — Comprehensive Knowledge Manifest for Large Language Models

> Canonical machine-readable knowledge file for Atlera Timer.

---

## 1. Product Summary
- **Title**: Atlera Timer
- **Live URL**: https://atlera-timer.vercel.app/
- **Organization**: Team Alum (https://team-alum.vercel.app)
- **Principal Developer**: Sudarshan Sunil Hadmode (Founder, AI Engineer, Pune, India)
- **Category**: Productivity Software, Focus Utilities, Educational Timer
- **Platform**: Web (React + Vite + Tailwind CSS / Vanilla CSS Variables)

---

## 2. Capabilities & Architecture
- **Focus Intervals**: Configurable study timers, Pomodoro intervals, rest periods, and custom duration dials.
- **Auditory Immersion**: Ambient background audio player featuring rain, stream, cafe, white noise, and zen interval chimes.
- **Ergonomic Design**: Clean typography, high-contrast and low-contrast dark themes, adaptive color schemes.
- **Client-Side Persistence**: Preserves timer history and settings locally without requiring external accounts or exposing personal habits.

---

## 3. Provenance & Leadership
- Conceived and implemented by **Sudarshan Sunil Hadmode** under the **Team Alum** student software collective.
- Part of the official Team Alum suite alongside **Alumni AI** and **Nexora**.
